title: Jesus Saves (New)
lyrics_original: Hear the heart of Heaven beating:
Hear His love and mercy pleading:
Hear the host of angels sing,
He has died our burden bearing.
He now lives our sorrows sharing.
See His love shine in the cross
Sin’s dark power now is broken.
See the Christ all full of grace,
Christ is calling, chains are falling,
Hope is dawning bright and true.
God is making all things new.
O to grace, how great a debtor!
All the saints now shout together!
Turn and know the risen Christ,
And we’ll sing His song forever:
Turn and know the risen Christ,
And we’ll sing His song forever:

bible_verses.english: There is salvation in no other, for neither is there any other name under heaven, that is given among men, by which we must be saved.
But God commends his own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
who himself bore our sins in his body on the tree, that we, having died to sins, might live to righteousness; by whose stripes you were healed.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for bearing the heavy burden of my sin upon the cross and rising to give me eternal life. I am deeply grateful that You walk beside me, sharing in my sorrows and filling my heart with joy. Help me to live today in the freedom and hope of Your salvation. May my life daily echo the song of heaven, declaring Your love and grace. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: The joyful news of salvation echoes from the heart of heaven straight into our daily lives. Jesus did not observe our pain from afar; He willingly carried the weight of our sins on the cross and rose again to share in our daily sorrows. When we sing of His saving power, we join heaven's choir in proclaiming hope to a weary world. May your heart be lifted today as you rest in the triumphant truth that Jesus saves.
